g.text: Wi-Fi Generations, Bluetooth, NFC, and Thunderbolt
Key Technology Terms for the Exam

text.tspan: Multiple Input Multiple Output. Multiple antennas for faster
Multi-User MIMO. AP talks to multiple devices
Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiple Access. Divides
Transmits across multiple bands simultaneously. Wi-Fi 7

g.text: Wi-Fi 6 = OFDMA (dense environments). Wi-Fi 7 = MLO (multi-band). Bluetooth Class 2 = 10m (most common).
